# PR image assets

Images rendered with HTML Preview from the real Finverse components using synthetic holdings and deterministic demo history. No personal portfolio data is included.

- `01`: shared holding history at the bottom of Insights.
- `02`: Software services hover highlights TCS and Infosys.
- `03`: shared Research chart directly below Your holding.
- `04` and `05`: global privacy control on desktop and mobile; desktop also shows INR-only preferences.
- `06` and `07`: baseline preferences and Research chart at commit `09183c0`.

Component captures may omit unrelated sections to focus on the change. Import, storage, valuation, cancellation, and observation-gap behavior is covered by automated regression checks.
